local scn, done = ...
local function crate(pos, ang, nograv)
  local e = ents.Create("prop_physics") e:SetModel("models/props_junk/wood_crate001a.mdl")
  e:SetPos(pos) e:SetAngles(ang or Angle(0,0,0)) e:Spawn() e:Activate()
  if nograv then local p = e:GetPhysicsObject() p:EnableGravity(false) p:Wake() end
  return e
end
for _, e in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("prop_physics")) do e:Remove() end
local b = crate(Vector(600, -500, -123.6))          -- collision: B on the floor
local a = crate(Vector(600, -500, -40))             -- A dropped on B, re-dropped after B goes WORLD
local c = crate(Vector(400, -500, -40))             -- C goes WORLD itself and is dropped on D
local d = crate(Vector(400, -500, -123.6))
local k = crate(Vector(500, -500, -60), Angle(30, 0, 0), true)  -- keepupright target, floating tilted
local k2 = crate(Vector(300, -500, -60), Angle(0, 0, 60), true) -- roll 60
local samples, t = {}, 0
hook.Add("Think", "parity_lua_effects2", function()
  t = t + 1
  if t == 60 then
    b:SetCollisionGroup(COLLISION_GROUP_WORLD)
    c:SetCollisionGroup(COLLISION_GROUP_WORLD)
    k.upright = constraint.Keepupright(k, Angle(0, 0, 0), 0, 999999)
    k2.upright = constraint.Keepupright(k2, Angle(0, 0, 0), 0, 999999)
  end
  if t == 61 then
    a:SetPos(Vector(600, -500, -60)) a:GetPhysicsObject():SetVelocity(Vector(0,0,0)) a:GetPhysicsObject():Wake()
    c:SetPos(Vector(400, -500, -60)) c:GetPhysicsObject():SetVelocity(Vector(0,0,0)) c:GetPhysicsObject():Wake()
  end
  if t >= 58 and t <= 200 then
    local ka, kv = k:GetAngles(), k:GetPhysicsObject():GetAngleVelocity()
    local k2a = k2:GetAngles()
    samples[#samples + 1] = { t = t, a = a:GetPos().z, c = c:GetPos().z, b = b:GetPos().z, d = d:GetPos().z,
      k = { ka.p, ka.y, ka.r, kv.x, kv.y, kv.z }, k2 = { k2a.p, k2a.y, k2a.r } }
  end
  if t == 201 then
    hook.Remove("Think", "parity_lua_effects2")
    done({ samples = samples, k_upright = IsValid(k.upright), k_keyvalues = IsValid(k.upright) and k.upright:GetKeyValues() or {},
      k_table = IsValid(k.upright) and k.upright:GetTable() or {} })
  end
end)
return "async"
